questions.question_te: జల ఉత్పాదకత గురించి సరైన వివరణ/సంబంధం ఏది?
options: Water loss as vapour from soil or open-water surfaces
Downward water movement through soil layers
Water vapour loss through plant processes
Useful crop output per specified water quantity
option_explanations: ఈ వివరణ ఆవిరీభవనం (Evaporation)కు చెందినది. జల ఉత్పాదకతకు సరైన సంబంధం: Useful crop output per specified water quantity.
ఈ వివరణ లోతుకు జల చలనం (Percolation)కు చెందినది. జల ఉత్పాదకతకు సరైన సంబంధం: Useful crop output per specified water quantity.
ఈ వివరణ స్వేదనం (Transpiration)కు చెందినది. జల ఉత్పాదకతకు సరైన సంబంధం: Useful crop output per specified water quantity.
Denominator irrigation/ET/withdrawal explicit కావాలి. Useful crop output per specified water quantity.

questions.question_en: Which pair confuses source with application method?
questions.question_te: Source/application methodను కలిపేసే statement ఏది?
options: A canal conveys surface water
Drip is always a separate groundwater source
A well extracts groundwater
A tank stores water
option_explanations: This source/conveyance relation is correct.
Drip describes application, not the origin of water.
This is the normal source relation.
Storage is a tank function.

questions.question_en: Why does direct-seeded rice not guarantee the same result at every farm?
questions.question_te: DSR every farm same result ఎందుకు కాదు?
options: Weeds, soil, variety, timing and water management differ
All fields are identical
Seeds eliminate every agronomic constraint
Water and labour never matter
option_explanations: Performance depends on the farming system.
Field conditions differ.
Management remains necessary.
Both affect feasibility and outcome.
questions.heading: పాఠం 1C — సాగునీరు: చెరువు, కాలువ, బావి నుంచి SRI వరకు
questions.excerpt: Transplanting nursery seedlingsను main fieldలో నాటడం; direct seeding seedsను fieldలో sow చేయడం. DSR water/labour changes site-specific; weed management, soil moisture, crop establishmentను కొత్త విధంగా manage చేయాలి. Every DSR field automatically highest yield/lowest water కాదు.

questions.question_en: Why can field irrigation savings differ from basin-wide water savings?
questions.question_te: Field/basin water savings ఎందుకు వేరవచ్చు?
options: Every seepage loss leaves Earth permanently
All saved water is automatically unused
Accounting boundary has no effect
Some field losses become downstream return flow or recharge
option_explanations: Seepage can remain in the basin.
Reuse/expanded demand may occur.
The boundary defines what is counted.
Water pathways and reuse matter at larger scales.
questions.heading: పాఠం 1C — సాగునీరు: చెరువు, కాలువ, బావి నుంచి SRI వరకు
questions.excerpt: Flooded paddyలో evaporation, transpiration, seepage/percolation components ఉంటాయి. Crop evapotranspiration, irrigation withdrawal ఒకటే కాదు; return flows/recharge basin accountingలో ముఖ్యం. Field-level saving always equal basin-level saving అని కాదు.
